source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The compose indent and outdent buttons now use doStyleUICommand and map to document.execCommand, replacing the internal goDoCommand path. The patch adds browser_indentOutdent.js, which checks no indent, two nested indents, and both outdents through the toolbar. Keep the button command mapping and actual editor output covered together when changing compose formatting.
title: Route compose indent commands through the editor style command map
